notes: Settings → Products → Overview now shows an always-visible diagnostic chip after the background sync runs: 'Synced N from Stripe · portal sees M bundles'. Green when they match (good), amber when they don't (= portal and backend resolving different msspId — the chip tells us exactly where the mismatch is so I can fix the underlying gap)

Portal now passes its own msspId to the sync endpoint so writes always land where the portal is reading. Eliminates a silent failure mode when BASEWISER_MSSP_ID env var is set to a value different from the Deployment table singleton
